english.note: Use this written phrase when separate elements form a coherent and well-integrated whole.

examples.english: The music, visuals, and story form an organic whole, giving the film a great atmosphere.
examples.traditional: 音樂、畫面同故事渾然一體，成套戲好有氣氛。
